texts.en:
Our response seems to have left the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] quite speechless. As soon as they received it, they fell completely silent, and we have heard little from them since. We can only speculate as to the meaning of this.

In the meantime, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have been hard at work translating what we know of their language. Hopefully, once they have made sufficient progress, we will be able to make sense of this.

texts.zh: [This.ContactCountry.GetName]通过大幅度增强其传输强度以回应了我们的挑衅。现在它们吵得[This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]已经不能忍受了，但是通过大幅调低音量，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]可以收集大量数据，他们相信这可能是翻译外星语言的关键——假设，在噪音的某个地方，可以发现某种语言。
texts.en: The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] responded to our challenge by significantly increasing the intensity of their transmissions. They are now too loud for [This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural] to tolerate, but by turning the volume down considerably, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] are able to gather a large amount of data that they believe may hold the key to translating the aliens' language - assuming that, somewhere in the noise, there is a language to be found.
